name: CN_RS_RULE_ASSIGNMENTS_INT
description: This is an interface table  of rule assignment which holds  rule assignment records before validate and import into Incentive Compensation rule assignments base table.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: This is the SYSTASK_ID for a given Job in MKT_IMP_JOBS

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: This column is required by import wizard to relate record in the interface table to the file row.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: INTERFACE_ROW_ID is the unique identifier for the record with in a batch.

columns.name: FILE_NAME_SYSTASK_ID
columns.description: The column saves the individual sys task id for each input csv file, corresponding to value in the mkt_cm_systask table.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: This column indicates import wizard if the import to base table was successful or Errored out

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: This is an optional column and would be useful if consumers want any error message as the first error.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Specifies insert or update operation to be performed on a record.

columns.name: INTERNAL_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Used by the ODI import logic

columns.name: RULE_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier of base table CN_RS_RULES_ALL_B.

columns.name: RULE_NUMBER
columns.description: The public unique identifier.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Name of the rule

columns.name: USAGE_ID
columns.description: Indicates Rule usage. Foreign key to cn_rs_usages_all.usage_id

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: ASSIGNED_OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: Assigned Object Name receives the participant name, credit category namey, role name, analyst name based on the rule usage.

columns.name: ASSIGNED_OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates whether the assignment is a resource or group or team or eligible category. It contains lookup code value

columns.name: END_DATE

columns.name: ROLE_ID

columns.name: SPLIT_PCT

columns.name: REVENUE_TYPE

columns.name: ROLLUP_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether rollup will be done for the credit receiver

columns.name: GROUP_MEMBER_CREDIT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicated in rollup hierarchy whether a member of the group  will get credit for other group member direct credits.

columns.name: SUMMARY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether participant will receive summarized direct credit or individual direct credit as indirect credits

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
